scientific_limitations_and_integrity: Over C, n>=2, d>=4, explicit coordinate-pair centers only; no claim for arbitrary centers or positive characteristic. The known Fermat plane quintic D4 case is acknowledged. Exact checks through d=25 support but cannot prove the all-degree theorem. A closely related unpublished manuscript cited as in preparation could affect originality. The present finding has no independent audit.
title: Hyperoctahedral monodromy and branching of Fermat coordinate-pair projections
